dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Some of the rookies we've gotten lately are really undisciplined. We really need to straighten them out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should cut the rookies some slack.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Absolutely not. On a job like this, where you're constantly surrounded by danger, what each person does affects the survival of everyone. Even the rookies need to understand that.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: The Wild Hunt won't spare you just because you're a rookie. A single moment of complacency can lead to consequences you can't undo later.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Discipline is our last line of defense at times like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: How's work with the logistics squad treating you, Ms. Gabieta?

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: You needn't worry, Illuga. Everything's going smoothly. Just let me know if the outpost needs anything.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Um... don't you think you were sent here to the logistics squad so you could take it a bit easier?

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: That won't do! If I were to "take it easy," those newcomers are really going to turn this place upside down!

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: "Sitting back and relaxing" sounds absolutely dreadful. So whatever that old man was thinking, he can drop it right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you really have to be so vigilant with logistics work, too?

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Of course. While logistics work may appear to be happening only far from the frontlines, every single supply run is crucial to the battle's outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: These supply runs are critical not just for the lives of our soldiers, but for the people they’re protecting as well. It's all in our hands, really.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: That's why I can't allow even the smallest mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your dedication and professionalism are truly admirable.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Oh come on now, these are all basic qualities that any Ratnik should have.
